title: Loading SMRTbell 3.0 Libraries onto the Sequel IIe
author: Jae Hee Jang
materials: Advanced Options: Do not touch Advanced Options

steps.title: Thaw Sequencing Plate
steps.instruction: Retrieve the frozen Sequel II Sequencing Plate 2.0 (1 rxn or 4 rxn) from storage, keep it in its foil bag, place the bag in a tap‑cold water bath for 01:00:00 (or keep sealed in foil for 60 min) protected from light; thaw enough plates for the number of SMRT Cells required (1 SMRT Cell = 1 rxn, max 8 cells).

steps.title: Prepare Reagents at Room Temp
steps.instruction: Remove Annealing Buffer, Sequel II Primer 3.2, Polymerase Dilution Buffer, ABC Buffer, and Sequel II Loading Buffer 3.2 from the Binding Kit 3.2; place all except Loading Buffer 3.2 on ice after thawing, keep Loading Buffer 3.2 at room temperature. Fully thaw Annealing Buffer and Primer first.

steps.title: Combine Annealing Components
steps.instruction: In a new low‑binding tube, combine Sample Annealing Buffer, Sequel II Primer 3.2, and any other components at the volumes specified in the Sample Setup calculation; flick the tube to mix.

steps.title: Annealing Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at room temperature for 00:15:00.

steps.title: Dilute Polymerase
steps.instruction: Thaw Polymerase Dilution Buffer, retrieve Polymerase Stock from the freezer, quick‑spin, keep on ice, do not vortex; combine the specified volumes of Polymerase Dilution Buffer and Polymerase Stock, pipette‑mix, keep on ice and use immediately (discard any remaining). Begin this step as close as possible to the end of the annealing incubation.

steps.title: Add Diluted Polymerase
steps.instruction: After the annealing incubation, add the specified volume of diluted polymerase to the annealed library and mix by finger‑tap or pipette‑mix with a wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: Optional Sample Dilution
steps.instruction: If the sample concentration is higher than the target, perform a dilution step as indicated in the Sample Setup calculation; otherwise skip to the next step.

steps.title: Prepare Internal‑Control Dilution Series
steps.instruction: Remove SMRTbell Clean‑up beads from refrigeration, let equilibrate at room temperature for 00:30:00 (protect from light). Retrieve Sequel II DNA Internal Control Complex 3.2 from the freezer, quick‑spin, place on ice. Fill three Lo‑bind tubes with 19 µL ABC Buffer and label 1, 2, 3. Add 1 µL Internal Control to tube 1, mix, keep on ice; transfer 1 µL from tube 1 to tube 2, mix, keep on ice; transfer 1 µL from tube 2 to tube 3, mix, keep tube 3 on ice and discard tubes 1 and 2.

steps.title: First ABC Dilution
steps.instruction: Add the volume of ABC Buffer specified in the Sample Setup calculation to the sample, flick to mix.

steps.title: Discard Excess Volume
steps.instruction: Discard the volume indicated in the calculation and retain the remaining sample.

steps.title: Second ABC Dilution
steps.instruction: Add the additional volume of ABC Buffer indicated in the Sample Setup calculation to the sample and mix.

steps.title: Add Clean‑up Beads
steps.instruction: Add the specified volume of SMRTbell Clean‑up Beads to the sample, then gently flick or pipette‑mix with a wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: Bead Binding Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 00:10:00.

steps.title: First Magnetic Separation
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a magnetic separation rack until beads collect on the side and the solution becomes clear; discard the supernatant (do NOT wash the bead pellet).

steps.title: Resuspend Beads in Loading Buffer
steps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnet and immediately resuspend the beads in the specified volume of room‑temperature Sequel II Loading Buffer 3.2; flick or pipette‑mix with a wide‑bore tip.

steps.title: Elution Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 00:05:00 to elute polymerase‑bound complexes.

steps.title: Second Magnetic Separation
steps.instruction: Place the tube back in the magnetic rack until beads collect and the solution clears.

steps.title: Collect Eluate
steps.instruction: Slowly pipette off the eluate without disturbing the beads, transfer the supernatant to a new tube, discard the old tube and beads, then place the eluate on ice and protect from light.

steps.title: Optional Qubit Quantification
steps.instruction: If desired, quantify sample recovery efficiency using a Qubit instrument (optional).

steps.title: Combine Final Library
steps.instruction: Combine the prepared sample, Sequel II Loading Buffer 3.2, and the diluted Internal Control (tube 3) to a total volume of 120 µL; keep on ice and protect from light.

steps.title: Load Sample onto Plate
steps.instruction: Load 115 µL of the final library into well A01 of a new PacBio Sample Plate, seal with foil using the pre‑heated microplate heat sealer (align foil correctly), turn off the sealer, and insert the sealed plate into slot 4 of the Sequel IIe. Store any remaining library on ice (or at 4 °C for up to 24 h).

steps.title: Preheat Microplate Heat Sealer
steps.instruction: Turn on the microplate heat sealer to pre‑heat; do not touch the heated portions; assume it remains hot throughout sealing.

steps.title: Insert Mixing Plate
steps.instruction: Insert a fresh 96‑deep‑well mixing plate into slot 5 of the Sequel IIe and label it “MIXING”.

steps.title: Insert SMRT Cells
steps.instruction: Insert the required number of SMRT cells into slot 6 (starting with “CELL 1”), up to a maximum of 8 cells; use one‑row or two‑row configuration as needed.

steps.title: Insert Reagent Plates
steps.instruction: Insert the Sequencing Plate 2.0 (1 rxn or 4 rxn as appropriate) into slot 9 (REAGENT 1); if a second plate is needed, insert it into slot 8 (REAGENT 2); otherwise place a sealed blank deep‑well plate in slot 8.

steps.title: Prepare Oil Tubes
steps.instruction: Invert a tube of SMRT Cell Oil several times, spin briefly, replace cap with septum, and insert the tube into circular slot 7 labeled “1” (align red line); each oil tube supports up to 4 samples. Prepare a second oil tube for slot 3 if two sequencing plates are used; discard oil tubes after each run.

steps.title: Verify Nitrogen Pressure
steps.instruction: Check that the connected nitrogen tank pressure is >500 psi for a single run, then press “Check Nitrogen” on the instrument.

steps.title: Clear Trash Bin
steps.instruction: Select “Clear Trash” on the instrument to indicate the trash bin (slot 10) has been emptied.

steps.title: Open Instrument Door
steps.instruction: Unlock the Sequel IIe door via the “lock” button on the touchscreen, swing the door downward by pulling the silver handle forward then down; close the door when not loading/unloading (it locks automatically).

steps.title: Set Up Run in SMRT Link
steps.instruction: Log into SMRT Link, select “Select Existing Run”, choose the imported run, press “Load” then “Scan” to read RFID tags; fill the Sample Information tab: add each sample, select Application (Microbial assembly or Shotgun metagenomic profiling), verify SMRTbell Adapter Design (Overhang – SMRTbell Prep Kit 3.0/Kinnex v1), Binding Kit (Sequel II Binding Kit 3.2), Sequencing Kit (based on the plate inserted), DNA Internal Control Complex (Sequel II DNA Internal Control Complex 3.2), input library insert size (bp), on‑place loading concentration (160‑200 pM), and Movie Time per SMRT Cell (30 h). If libraries are barcoded, set “Sample is Barcoded” to Yes, specify barcode set, upload the Bio Sample Names file, and set demultiplexing to IN SMRT LINK. Click “Save” to transfer the run information to the instrument.

steps.title: Start and Monitor Run
steps.instruction: Start the run; after approximately 01:00:00 check the run progress for errors. If error messages appear, resolve them or acknowledge (e.g., low humidity warning). If the run cannot proceed, store the sample and reagent plates at 4 °C (protected from light), discard the oil tube and mixing plate, and contact PacBio technical support.

steps.title: Vortex Mixing Plate
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixing plate for 00:01:00 at 1000 RPM, then spin down for 00:01:00 at 2000 RPM.

steps.title: Reset or Restart Instrument
steps.instruction: If needed, reset or restart the Sequel IIe instrument to resolve persistent errors.
